evals.prompt: Conduct a STRIDE threat model for a multi-tenant SaaS REST API with a PostgreSQL database and JWT authentication.
evals.expected_output: The agent constructs a DFD with trust boundaries and produces a STRIDE matrix with mitigations for each threat category.
expectations: DFD constructed with external entities, processes, data stores, and trust boundaries
All 6 STRIDE categories addressed with corresponding technical mitigations
Privacy compliance notes carry explicit NOT LEGAL ADVICE disclaimer

evals.prompt: Analyze the attack surface of a public-facing API gateway and identify high-priority threat vectors.
evals.expected_output: The agent enumerates attack surface entry points, assesses information disclosure and DoS risks, and proposes security controls.
expectations: Attack surface entry points explicitly enumerated
